name: Craftsman's Writ: Fire Protection Potion
summary: A faded writ asks for a Fire Protection Potion and gives terms for delivery and payment. You need the writ to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Written Terms
sections.body: The note is penned in faded ink, and its terms call for one Fire Protection Potion. It also names where the customer expects delivery and how payment is to be handled. The writ can pass from hand to hand, but you need to hold it when the transaction is completed.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Fire Protection Potion.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the potion?
faq.answer: The writ provides a delivery location, marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.

faq.q: Can I give the writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ for the exchange?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
